verdict.rationale: Google Drive API documents push notifications and a Changes resource that let apps watch for and be notified of file changes (google-drive-docs-9,19,28,35), which covers the core webhook/change-notification story. However the evidence pack does not show documented verification (e.g., channel token/signature validation) or retry/backoff semantics for these notifications. missing for 10: explicit verification (signature/token check) details, retry/backoff semantics, independent corroboration of reliability.
